benchmark_context.aot_codegen: LLVM O2; generic CPU; PIC; checked arithmetic; explicit roots
benchmark_context.dasprofile_cpp: GN Release flags; FP contraction disabled; stable_sort
benchmark_context.escape_allocation_sample: separate warmed Isolate; automatic GC disabled; one invocation
benchmark_context.jit_baseline: LLVM O2; host CPU; current dispatch; precise roots; safepoints
benchmark_context.jit_optimized: LLVM O2; host CPU; typed slots; SCC direct calls/inlining; body dependencies; selective recovery

measurement.summary: median, sample standard deviation, coefficient of variation and range
measurement.jit_preparation: Four source suite/tier images compiled once before calibration and sampling; fresh Isolate and publication per sample
measurement.memory_scope: Heap retention and frame cleanup validated. Resident counters share a process with LLVM and all prepared images; not independent backend footprints.

comparison_to_previous.reason: Same machine, toolchain, Release configuration, 24 workloads and 7 randomized 0.2s repetitions; suspended callbacks borrow the activation retained by their reference snapshot.

changes: Share the activation through one aliasing reference snapshot; the await callback borrows the activation from that snapshot instead of retaining a second shared owner.
Move the reference snapshot into ObserveResult after publishing KeepAlive ownership.
